description: Flat record-level metadata schema for ITS amplicon sequencing of fungi from forest soil samples across forest types and time points.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample or sequencing record. Example: FS_Trop_2024_001.

site_id.descr: Identifier for the sampling site where the sample was collected. Example: SITE_12.

forest_type.descr: Forest type/classification at the sampling site. Acceptable values may include temperate, tropical, boreal, subtropical, or mixed forest.

biome.descr: Broader ecological biome classification of the site. Example: temperate forest, tropical rainforest.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Example: 45.1234.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Example: -71.5678.

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site above sea level in meters.

country.descr: Country where the sample site is located.

region.descr: Administrative or ecological region/state/province of the sampling site.

sampling_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

time_point.descr: Sampling time point or campaign label used to capture temporal variation. Example: spring_2024, t1, dry_season.

season.descr: Season at the time of sampling. Example values: spring, summer, autumn/fall, winter, wet_season, dry_season.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Soil sampling depth interval in centimeters. Example: 0-10 cm represented as a numeric depth value or midpoint if preferred.

soil_pH.descr: Soil pH measured at the time of sampling or from a paired soil analysis.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent wet mass or gravimetric percentage, depending on lab protocol.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Organic matter content of the soil expressed as percent.

soil_type.descr: Soil classification or texture descriptor if available. Example: loam, clay, sandy loam, histosol.

litter_cover_percent.descr: Percent ground cover by litter at the sampling point, if recorded.

canopy_cover_percent.descr: Percent canopy cover above the sampling point, if recorded.

temperature_c.descr: Ambient or soil temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius, if recorded.

precipitation_mm.descr: Precipitation associated with the site or sampling period in millimeters, if recorded.

host_vegetation.descr: Dominant vegetation or tree species associated with the soil site, if relevant. Example: Quercus spp., mixed conifer.

habitat_descriptor.descr: Local habitat descriptor for the sample location. Example: forest floor, rhizosphere, bulk soil, litter layer.

soil_compartment.descr: Specific soil compartment sampled. Acceptable values may include bulk soil, rhizosphere, litter, or mineral soil.

sampling_replica.descr: Replica number or replicate label for repeated sampling at the same site/time point.

collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the soil sample. Example: soil corer, auger, sterile scoop.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of soil material collected for DNA extraction in grams.

dna_extraction_kit.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used. Example: DNeasy PowerSoil, MoBio PowerSoil.

pcr_target_region.descr: Amplified fungal barcode region. For this dataset, typically ITS1, ITS2, or full ITS.

primer_forward.descr: Forward PCR primer sequence or primer name used to amplify ITS regions.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse PCR primer sequence or primer name used to amplify ITS regions.

sequencing_platform.descr: Next-generation sequencing platform used. Example: Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, PacBio.

library_preparation_protocol.descr: Library preparation or amplicon preparation protocol used prior to sequencing.

read_length_bp.descr: Expected or observed read length in base pairs for the sequencing run.

sequence_run_id.descr: Identifier of the sequencing run or flow cell, if available.

barcode_index.descr: Sample barcode or index sequence used for multiplexing, if applicable.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequencing reads obtained for the sample before filtering.

filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality filtering and chimera removal, if available.

otus_asvs_count.descr: Number of OTUs or ASVs assigned to the sample after processing.

taxonomy_assignment_method.descr: Method or database used for fungal taxonomic assignment. Example: UNITE, BLAST, naïve Bayesian classifier.

database_version.descr: Reference database version used for taxonomic assignment, if applicable.

relative_abundance_unit.descr: Unit used for abundance values in the downstream table. Example: percent, proportion, read count.

qc_passed.descr: Indicates whether the sample passed quality control criteria.

control_sample.descr: Indicates whether the record is a control, blank, or mock community rather than an environmental sample.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on unusual sampling conditions, missing values, or processing issues.
